read.en: Lumentum fell 18.7% on Nov 5 to $509.70, gapping lower and trading between $506.69 and $596.82 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($668.3), 10-day ($761.6), 30-day ($895.9) and 100-day ($857.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($806.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($938.52), and RSI is 27.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月5日下跌 18.7%，收于 $509.70，跳空低开，盘中区间 $506.69–596.82，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$668.3）、10 日（$761.6）、30 日（$895.9）和 100 日均线（$857.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$806.7）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$938.52），RSI 为 27。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $594.8–602.3 late-July lows, now resistance with the $596.82 high, and the $550 round number. Resistance is $528–550 (Feb 17 and Mar 6 lows, $550), then $594.8–602.3 and $642.4–651. Support is $504.4–507.6 (Feb 5 close and high, Nov 5 low), then $464–465.5 (Feb 3 high, Feb 4 close) and $425–426 (Feb 4–5 lows). A close above $528 would target $548–550; below $504.4, $465.
